name: Aissistant Shop Manager
author: orlinkozarev1978

sections.description:
AIA replaces your shop manager role entirely.

No dashboards to check. No reports to read. No campaigns to set up manually.

AIA connects to your WooCommerce store and takes over — analysing performance, identifying opportunities, and executing improvements autonomously, day after day.

What AIA does for you:

  • Daily shop analysis — sales, trends, customer behaviour
  • Autonomous promotion suggestions and execution
  • Continuous shop development recommendations
  • Full WooCommerce integration — orders, products, customers

AIA works in the background so you can focus on your business, not on managing a tool.

External services

This plugin connects to the Camacam AI service in order to process AI requests and product automation features.

Service endpoint:
https://brains.aissistant.site

Data sent:
– Product titles
– Product descriptions
– Store-related content
– Error logs (when errors occur)

This data is sent only when the plugin functionality is used.

Terms of Service:
https://aissistant.site/terms-and-conditions.html

Privacy Policy:
https://aissistant.site/privacy-policy.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin — WooCommerce must be installed and active
  3. Navigate to Aia in the WordPress admin menu
  4. AIA enrolls your store automatically — no manual configuration needed
sections.faq:
Does this work without WooCommerce?

No. AIA is built exclusively for WooCommerce stores.

Do I need an account?

Yes. AIA connects to the aissistant.site platform. An account is created automatically on first activation.

Does it replace my existing setup?

AIA works alongside your existing WooCommerce setup. It adds an autonomous management layer on top without disrupting what you already have.

How does AIA update?

AIA checks for updates automatically and notifies you in the WordPress Plugins page when a new version is available.
